install.q: Do you install what you sell?
install.a: Yes. For heat pumps, pellet stoves and boilers, air conditioners and underfloor heating we offer turnkey installation: a site visit, the installation and commissioning. Request a site visit and we will send you a quote.

vat.a: Yes. Every price in the shop is in euros and includes VAT.

delivery.a: It depends on the manufacturer's stock. We confirm the date after the order, and for units with installation we agree on a day after the site visit.

power.q: How do I know what power I need?
power.a: Our calculators for heat pumps, air conditioners and radiators give you a guide. We set the exact power at the site visit, from the insulation, the windows and how you use the home.

returns.a: Yes. You have 14 days from delivery to withdraw from an online purchase without giving a reason, with the exceptions the law provides.

payment.a: By card online when you order. Payment goes through Stripe, and your card details never reach us.

cta.title: Not sure what you need?
